highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 bumps to Skia milestone m152 and adds a Silk.NET-backed Vulkan package.
highlights_body: Ships several native use-after-free and memory-leak fixes, adds FreeType-based Nano Server font support, and converts all solutions to the .slnx format.

bullets.detail: Bumps the bundled Skia engine to Chrome milestone m152, plus a follow-up servicing sync and further m151 stability fixes.
Adds a Silk.NET-backed Vulkan interop package, with Vulkan tests now running on Android and Linux.
Adds RequestReadPixels to SKImage and SKSurface for asynchronous, backend-neutral pixel reads.

bullets.lead: Fixed several native use-after-free and leak issues
bullets.detail: Roots the SKRegion in SpanIterator to fix a use-after-free, roots the pixel source in SKPixmap.ExtractSubset and With* methods, and fixes a CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in the SKImage.Create raster failure path.

bullets.lead: Reduced allocations in more hot paths
bullets.detail: Caches the HandleDictionary skip-registration reflection check, avoids an intermediate string allocation in GetEncodedText, pre-sizes the SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map, and avoids a double buffer copy in SKData.SaveTo.
Adds FreeType-backed font support for Windows Nano Server, and initializes the MSVC environment once per native build to speed up Windows builds.
Makes binding generation deterministic across platforms, and adds containerized Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server test legs.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-based font support for Windows Nano Server
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Initialized the MSVC environment once per native build
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Opened the 4.152.0 line with the Skia m152 milestone bump, the new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, several native use-after-free and memory-leak fixes, and FreeType-based Nano Server font support.

harfbuzz_summary: Converts the HarfBuzzSharp solution to .slnx format and adds containerized test legs to broaden platform coverage for the binding.
